title: "Q03. Workplace"

**Which geographical region are you currently working or attending
school/university in?**

Answered on the UN geoscheme, split here into a regional and a subregional
level.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent.parent))
from _helpers import bar, grouped_bar, load_bivariate, load_univariate, suppression_note  # noqa: E402
```

## By region

```{python}
# | echo: false
bar(load_univariate("q03_regional"), "q03_regional", title="Q03. Workplace region")
```

## By subregion

```{python}
# | echo: false
bar(load_univariate("q03_subregional"), "q03_subregional", title="Q03. Workplace subregion")
```

Europe accounts for about half of the respondents, followed by Asia (with
Japan the largest single subregion) and the Americas.

## Gender balance by region

```{python}
# | echo: false
grouped_bar(
    load_bivariate("q03_regional", "q02"),
    "q03_regional",
    "q02",
    title="Q03 region x Q02",
    normalize=True,
)
```

## Gender balance by subregion

```{python}
# | echo: false
grouped_bar(
    load_bivariate("q03_subregional", "q02"),
    "q03_subregional",
    "q02",
    title="Q03 subregion x Q02",
    normalize=True,
)
```
